summary.title: One-loop QED vertex: a_e = alpha/2pi and the Lamb shift
summary.verdict: Ward-Takahashi and a_e=alpha/2pi exact; Uehling coefficient derived from F251; Lamb shift lifts the Dirac degeneracy to 99.5% of the measured 1057.845 MHz (leading order).

wt.statement: q_m Lambda^m = S^{-1}(p') - S^{-1}(p) exactly (literal 0) with the F87 identity-channel vertex; fixes Z1 = Z2. Loop counterpart of F251's transverse self-energy.

ae.note: leading (Schwinger) term only; (alpha/pi)^2,... higher QED orders close the residual 0.15% and are out of scope.
ae.statement: one-loop vertex F_2(0) = alpha/2pi EXACTLY (parametric integral = 1); a_e = 1.16141e-3 vs measured 1.15965e-3 (0.15%).

uehling.statement: Pi(q^2) -> (alpha/15pi) q^2/m^2 at low q (from int x^2(1-x)^2 = 1/30); Uehling S-state coefficient -4/15, derived from the F251 bubble.

lamb.statement: one-loop radiative shift lifts the exact Dirac 2s-2p degeneracy to +1052.2 MHz = 99.5% of the measured 1057.845 MHz; Uehling (-27.1 MHz) derived from F251, self-energy (+1079 MHz) from the Bethe log (literature input). Residual ~5.6 MHz is higher-order alpha(Z alpha)^5/two-loop QED, out of leading-order scope.

V3_uehling_coefficient.quantity: Uehling S-state coefficient from F251 bubble low-q

V4_lamb_shift.note: leading order; residual ~5.6 MHz is higher-order QED.
